verses.original: בְּיָמָ֣יו נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּ֖ר מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל עָלָ֔ה יְהוֹיָקִ֥ים וַיְהִי־ ל֨וֹ עֶ֙בֶד֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וַיָּ֖שָׁב וַיִּמְרָד־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·yā·māw nə·ḇu·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar me·leḵ bā·ḇel ‘ā·lāh yə·hō·w·yā·qîm way·hî- lōw ‘e·ḇeḏ šā·lōš šā·nîm way·yā·šāḇ way·yim·rāḏ- bōw
verses.literal: During Jehoiakim’s reign Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invaded So Jehoiakim became his vassal for three years until he turned and rebelled against [Nebuchadnezzar]

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה׀ וַיְשַׁלַּ֣ח כַשְׂדִּים֩ וְאֶת־ גְּדוּדֵ֨י אֲרָ֜ם וְאֵ֣ת׀ גְּדוּדֵ֣י מוֹאָ֗ב וְאֵת֙ גְּדוּדֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־ עַמּ֔וֹן גְּדוּדֵ֣י בּ֡וֹ אֶת־ וַיְשַׁלְּחֵ֥ם לְהַֽאֲבִיד֑וֹ בִּֽיהוּדָ֖ה כִּדְבַ֣ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּיַ֖ד עֲבָדָ֥יו הַנְּבִיאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·šal·laḥ ḵaś·dîm wə·’eṯ- gə·ḏū·ḏê ’ă·rām wə·’êṯ gə·ḏū·ḏê mō·w·’āḇ wə·’êṯ gə·ḏū·ḏê ḇə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn gə·ḏū·ḏê bōw ’eṯ- way·šal·lə·ḥêm lə·ha·’ă·ḇî·ḏōw bî·hū·ḏāh kiḏ·ḇar ’ă·šer Yah·weh dib·ber bə·yaḏ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw han·nə·ḇî·’îm
verses.literal: And the LORD sent Chaldean - - Aramean - - Moabite - - and Ammonite . . . raiders against [Jehoiakim] - [in order] to destroy Judah according to the word that the LORD had spoken through His servants the prophets

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ׀ הָֽיְתָה֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה עַל־ יְהוָ֗ה פִּ֣י לְהָסִ֖יר מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֑יו בְּחַטֹּ֣את מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ hā·yə·ṯāh bî·hū·ḏāh ‘al- Yah·weh pî lə·hā·sîr mê·‘al pā·nāw bə·ḥaṭ·ṭōṯ mə·naš·šeh kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: Surely this happened to Judah at the LORD’s command to remove them from His presence because of the sins of Manasseh and all that he had done

verses.original: וְגַ֤ם הַנָּקִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דַּֽם־ שָׁפָ֔ךְ וַיְמַלֵּ֥א אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם נָקִ֑י דָּ֣ם יְהוָ֖ה אָבָ֥ה וְלֹֽא־ לִסְלֹֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam han·nā·qî ’ă·šer dam- šā·p̄āḵ way·mal·lê ’eṯ- yə·rū·šā·lim nā·qî dām Yah·weh ’ā·ḇāh wə·lō- lis·lō·aḥ
verses.literal: and also for the innocent - blood he had shed For he had filled - Jerusalem with innocent blood and the LORD was unwilling - to forgive

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוֹיָקִ֖ים וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֵ֣ם הֲלֹא־ כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê yə·hō·w·yā·qîm wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hêm hă·lō- kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim along with all his accomplishments . . . are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Judah

verses.original: יְהוֹיָקִ֖ים וַיִּשְׁכַּ֥ב עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֑יו בְּנ֖וֹ יְהוֹיָכִ֥ין וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hō·w·yā·qîm way·yiš·kaḇ ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw bə·nōw yə·hō·w·yā·ḵîn way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Jehoiakim rested with his fathers and his son Jehoiachin reigned in his place

verses.original: מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם וְלֹֽא־ לָצֵ֖את מֵֽאַרְצ֑וֹ הֹסִ֥יף עוֹד֙ כִּֽי־ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֗ל לָקַ֞ח כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיְתָ֖ה לְמֶ֥לֶךְ מִצְרָֽיִם׃פ מִנַּ֤חַל מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ עַד־ פְּרָ֔ת נְהַר־
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ miṣ·ra·yim wə·lō- lā·ṣêṯ mê·’ar·ṣōw hō·sîp̄ ‘ō·wḏ kî- me·leḵ bā·ḇel lā·qaḥ kōl ’ă·šer hā·yə·ṯāh lə·me·leḵ miṣ·rā·yim min·na·ḥal miṣ·ra·yim ‘aḏ- pə·rāṯ nə·har-
verses.literal: Now the king of Egypt did not march out of his land again . . . because the king of Babylon had taken all - his territory . . . . . . from the Brook of Egypt to the Euphrates River

verses.original: יְהוֹיָכִ֣ין שְׁמֹנֶ֨ה עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה בֶּן־ שָׁנָה֙ בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֔ים אִמּ֔וֹ וְשֵׁ֣ם נְחֻשְׁתָּ֥א בַת־ אֶלְנָתָ֖ן מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hō·w·yā·ḵîn šə·mō·neh ‘eś·rêh ben- šā·nāh bə·mā·lə·ḵōw mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim ū·šə·lō·šāh ḥo·ḏā·šîm ’im·mōw wə·šêm nə·ḥuš·tā ḇaṯ- ’el·nā·ṯān mî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Jehoiachin was eighteen . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem three months His mother’s name was Nehushta daughter of Elnathan she was from Jerusalem

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ אָבִֽיו׃ עָשָׂ֖ה
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ’ā·ḇîw ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD just as - his father had done

verses.original: הַהִ֔יא בָּעֵ֣ת עַבְדֵ֛י נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל עָלָה יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הָעִ֖יר וַתָּבֹ֥א בַּמָּצֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hî bā·‘êṯ ‘aḇ·ḏê nə·ḇu·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ʿå̄·lå̄h yə·rū·šā·lim hā·‘îr wat·tā·ḇō bam·mā·ṣō·wr
verses.literal: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched up to Jerusalem and the city came under siege

verses.original: נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל וַיָּבֹ֛א עַל־ הָעִ֑יר וַעֲבָדָ֖יו צָרִ֥ים עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel way·yā·ḇō ‘al- hā·‘îr wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ṣā·rîm ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it . . .

verses.original: יְהוֹיָכִ֤ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָה֙ וְאִמּ֔וֹ וַעֲבָדָ֖יו וְשָׂרָ֣יו וְסָֽרִיסָ֑יו וַיֵּצֵ֞א עַל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל ה֣וּא שְׁמֹנֶ֖ה בִּשְׁנַ֥ת לְמָלְכֽוֹ׃ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וַיִּקַּ֤ח אֹתוֹ֙
verses.transliteration: yə·hō·w·yā·ḵîn me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’im·mōw wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw wə·śā·rāw wə·sā·rî·sāw way·yê·ṣê ‘al- me·leḵ bā·ḇel hū šə·mō·neh biš·naṯ lə·mā·lə·ḵōw me·leḵ bā·ḇel way·yiq·qaḥ ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Jehoiachin king of Judah his mother his servants his commanders and his officials [all] surrendered to the king of Babylon . . . So in the eighth year of his reign the king of Babylon took him captive -

verses.original: כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֖ר יְהוָֽה׃ דִּבֶּ֥ר וַיּוֹצֵ֣א מִשָּׁ֗ם אֶת־ כָּל־ אוֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְאֽוֹצְר֖וֹת הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ בֵּ֣ית וַיְקַצֵּ֞ץ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַזָּהָ֗ב כְּלֵ֣י אֲשֶׁ֨ר שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עָשָׂ֜ה בְּהֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh dib·ber way·yō·w·ṣê miš·šām ’eṯ- kāl- ’ō·wṣ·rō·wṯ bêṯ Yah·weh wə·’ō·wṣ·rō·wṯ ham·me·leḵ bêṯ way·qaṣ·ṣêṣ ’eṯ- kāl- haz·zā·hāḇ kə·lê ’ă·šer šə·lō·mōh me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘ā·śāh bə·hê·ḵal Yah·weh
verses.literal: As the LORD had declared [Nebuchadnezzar] also carried off . . . - all the treasures from the house of the LORD [and] the royal palace and he cut into pieces - all the gold articles that Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the LORD

verses.original: וְהִגְלָ֣ה אֶת־ כָּל־ יְ֠רוּשָׁלִַם וְֽאֶת־ כָּל־ הַשָּׂרִ֞ים וְאֵ֣ת׀ כָּל־ גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י הַחַ֗יִל וְכָל־ הֶחָרָ֖שׁ וְהַמַּסְגֵּ֑ר עֲשָׂרָה אֲלָפִים֙ גּוֹלֶ֔ה זוּלַ֖ת לֹ֣א דַּלַּ֥ת עַם־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ נִשְׁאַ֔ר
verses.transliteration: wə·hiḡ·lāh ’eṯ- kāl- yə·rū·šā·lim wə·’eṯ- kāl- haś·śā·rîm wə·’êṯ kāl- gib·bō·w·rê ha·ḥa·yil wə·ḵāl he·ḥā·rāš wə·ham·mas·gêr ʿă·śå̄·rå̄h ’ă·lā·p̄îm gō·w·leh zū·laṯ lō dal·laṯ ‘am- hā·’ā·reṣ niš·’ar
verses.literal: He carried into exile - all Jerusalem - all the commanders and mighty men of valor all the craftsmen and metalsmiths ten thousand captives [in all] Only - the poorest people of the land remained

verses.original: וַיֶּ֥גֶל אֶת־ יְהוֹיָכִ֖ין בָּבֶ֑לָה וְאֶת־ הַ֠מֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־ אֵ֣ם הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ וְאֶת־ נְשֵׁ֨י סָרִיסָ֗יו וְאֵת֙ אֱוִלֵי הָאָ֔רֶץ הוֹלִ֛יךְ גּוֹלָ֥ה מִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בָּבֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye·ḡel ’eṯ- yə·hō·w·yā·ḵîn bā·ḇe·lāh wə·’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ wə·’eṯ- ’êm ham·me·leḵ wə·’eṯ- nə·šê sā·rî·sāw wə·’êṯ ʾɛ̆·wi·lē hā·’ā·reṣ hō·w·lîḵ gō·w·lāh mî·rū·šā·lim bā·ḇe·lāh
verses.literal: Nebuchadnezzar carried away - Jehoiachin to Babylon as well as the king’s - mother [his] - wives his officials and the leading men . . . of the land He took them into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon

verses.original: וְאֵת֩ מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֛ל וַיְבִיאֵ֧ם גּוֹלָ֖ה בָּבֶֽלָה׃ כָּל־ שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֗ים אַנְשֵׁ֨י הַחַ֜יִל אֶ֔לֶף וְהֶחָרָ֤שׁ וְהַמַּסְגֵּר֙ הַכֹּ֕ל גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים עֹשֵׂ֣י מִלְחָמָ֑ה
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ me·leḵ- bā·ḇel way·ḇî·’êm gō·w·lāh bā·ḇe·lāh kāl- šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ’an·šê ha·ḥa·yil ’e·lep̄ wə·he·ḥā·rāš wə·ham·mas·gêr hak·kōl gib·bō·w·rîm ‘ō·śê mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: - The king of Babylon also brought into exile to Babylon all seven thousand men of valor and a thousand craftsmen and metalsmiths all strong and fit for battle

verses.original: מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֛ל אֶת־ מַתַּנְיָ֥ה דֹד֖וֹ וַיַּמְלֵ֧ךְ תַּחְתָּ֑יו וַיַּסֵּ֥ב אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ צִדְקִיָּֽהוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ’eṯ- mat·tan·yāh ḏō·ḏōw way·yam·lêḵ taḥ·tāw way·yas·sêḇ ’eṯ- šə·mōw ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū
verses.literal: Then the king of Babylon - made Mattaniah [Jehoiachin’s] uncle king in his place and changed - his name to Zedekiah

verses.original: צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְאַחַ֤ת בֶּן־ שָׁנָה֙ בְמָלְכ֔וֹ מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְאַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה אִמּ֔וֹ וְשֵׁ֣ם חֲמִיטַל בַּֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מִלִּבְנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū ‘eś·rîm wə·’a·ḥaṯ ben- šā·nāh ḇə·mā·lə·ḵōw mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·’a·ḥaṯ ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh ’im·mōw wə·šêm ḥă·mī·ṭal baṯ- yir·mə·yā·hū mil·liḇ·nāh
verses.literal: Zedekiah was twenty-one . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven . . . years His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah she was from Libnah

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוֹיָקִֽים׃ עָשָׂ֖ה
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- yə·hō·w·yā·qîm ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: And [Zedekiah] did evil in the sight of the LORD just as - Jehoiakim had done

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ עַל־ אַ֣ף יְהוָ֗ה הָיְתָ֤ה בִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ וּבִ֣יהוּדָ֔ה עַד־ הִשְׁלִכ֥וֹ אֹתָ֖ם מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֑יו צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ וַיִּמְרֹ֥ד בְּמֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ‘al- ’ap̄ Yah·weh hā·yə·ṯāh ḇî·rū·šā·lim ū·ḇî·hū·ḏāh ‘aḏ- hiš·li·ḵōw ’ō·ṯām mê·‘al pā·nāw ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū way·yim·rōḏ bə·me·leḵ bā·ḇel
verses.literal: For because of the anger of the LORD [all this] happened in Jerusalem and Judah until He finally banished them from His presence And Zedekiah also rebelled against the king of Babylon
